exam_exercises.text: Part 1 — Multiple Choice (۲۰ نمره — هر سؤال ۲ نمره)

items.question: Solar energy ______ used to heat water.
This wind turbine ______ repaired next week.
Before scientists found clean energy, people ______ only fossil fuels.
Dangerous gases ______ produced when we burn garbage.
She ______ never seen a wind farm before this trip.
When we reached the solar farm, the workers ______ already left.
New solar panels ______ installed on our school roof.
He ______ studied renewable energy before he became an engineer.
Waste ______ changed into useful energy in some factories.

exam_exercises.text: Part 2 — Change the Active Sentences to Passive with Modals (۱۵ نمره — هر جمله ۳ نمره)

exam_exercises.instruction: Change the Active Sentences to Passive with Modals

items.answer: Wind can be converted into electricity.
items.text: Engineers can convert wind into electricity. → ______________________________

items.answer: Energy must be saved every day.
items.text: People must save energy every day. → ______________________________

items.answer: New clean energy sources may be discovered.
items.text: Scientists may discover new clean energy sources. → ______________________________

items.answer: The use of fossil fuels should be reduced.
items.text: We should reduce the use of fossil fuels. → ______________________________

exam_exercises.text: Part 3 — Choose the Correct Verb Form: Simple Past or Past Perfect (۱۵ نمره — هر سؤال ۳ نمره)

exam_exercises.instruction: Choose the Correct Verb Form: Simple Past or Past Perfect

items.text: Before we visited the wind farm, we ______ (learn/had learned) about wind energy.
When the workers arrived, the sun ______ (rose/had already risen).
She ______ (installed/had installed) solar panels before she moved to that house.
After the storm ______ (stopped/had stopped), we went outside.
I ______ (never/had never) used solar energy before last year.

exam_exercises.text: Part 4 — Rewrite the Sentences (۱۵ نمره — هر جمله ۵ نمره)

items.answer: Energy must be saved for future generations.
items.task: Rewrite in the passive voice with a modal:
items.text: We must save energy for future generations.

items.answer: Before we discovered clean energy, we had used only fossil fuels.
items.text: We discovered clean energy. Before that, we used only fossil fuels.

items.answer: She had never seen a solar panel before.
items.text: She had never see a solar panel before.

exam_exercises.text: Part 5 — Reading and Choosing the Best Word (۱۵ نمره — هر جای خالی ۳ نمره)

exam_exercises.instruction: Read the paragraph and choose the correct word.
exam_exercises.passage: Clean energy should/should be used more often. Before scientists discovered/had discovered solar power, people used/had used only fossil fuels for many years. Wind can/can be changed into electricity by wind turbines. Dangerous gases may/may be produced when we burn garbage, so we must/must be find better ways to make energy.
